audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. The stated positive n-dimensional image measure contradicts the Lusin N property in the same paragraph.; Two exact equalities/inequalities omit multiplicative normalization.; The explicit constant does not cover the allowed one-dimensional case.
limitations: F1 — Counterevidence: Dimension n and zero H^n measure are compatible, and the main theorems impose the correct zero-measure conclusions.
F2 — Counterevidence: Multiplication of a gauge by a positive constant does not change zero sets or finiteness of its Hausdorff measure.
F3 — Counterevidence: The corrected one-dimensional estimate is attained by the clamp example for alpha=1 and agrees with the theorem's qualitative conclusions.

F4 — Counterevidence: The already established (4.6) supplies the replacement B(z)/z^n argument; it is not a separately printed proof of(4.17)/(4.18). The source's actual proof uses false(4.20) and the different v/B^-1(v). Neither the gauge lemma nor Theorem3.1 is refuted.
F5 — Counterevidence: The construction gives precisely the final power predicted by(3.26), so it is not a counterexample to that final gauge or Theorem3.1.
F6 — Counterevidence: The positive-volume parameter calculation and its homogeneity are consistent with(3.18); no counterexample to that bound was obtained.
F7 — Counterevidence: The theorem only needs asymptotic cardinality and bounded branching. The corrected construction preserves the exact exponents and works also for n=1,q>0.
Limitations: External Orlicz-Morrey inequality and general Hausdorff-content continuity were not fully independently reproved.
Limitations: No equivalence between the acquired v2 and journal version established.

proposition.claim:
The stated positive n-dimensional image measure contradicts the Lusin N property in the same paragraph.

Two exact equalities/inequalities omit multiplicative normalization.

The explicit constant does not cover the allowed one-dimensional case.

The denominator lacks its n-th power; the cited monotonicity is correspondingly insufficient as written.

The exponential inverse is not determined up to multiplicative constants by the stated slowly varying comparability.

The zero-measure branch takes the auxiliary parameter in the wrong direction; image-content labels are inconsistent with m>=n.

The printed Cantor cylinder mass exponent is inconsistent, and exact counts cannot start at j=1 for every permitted parameter.

repair.content:
Retain only the supported full-dimension statement, with zero n-dimensional measure allowed; remove the positive-measure inference.

Use the displayed exact constants or explicitly state multiplicative equivalence. Theorem3.4's actual limit condition(2.6) remains the correct substantive hypothesis.

Restrict the n'-p' formula to n>=2 and state the one-dimensional Holder estimate separately.

Restore the exponent n and use B(z)/z^n monotonicity, not merely the Young-function property B(z)/z.

Use logarithmic comparability/two exponential bounds. Also read the displayed J(s) asymptotics on pp.14-15 near zero, not the printed near-infinity label.

Use r->infinity for zero volume and H^n_infinity for all target images in the proof. Zero-content cases of Theorem3.5 may invoke3.1(ii), covering phi=r^n as well.

Use2^{-jnu}, begin at sufficiently fine levels, and use asymptotic counts with bounded integer branching. State the l1 justification and retain fixed comparison constants.
